### Pull request checklist

Please confirm the basics below before requesting review:

1. Open the pull request against the `main` branch.
2. Format the title as `<type>: <description>`.
3. Use one of the documented types: `feat`, `fix`, `breaking`, `refactor`, `test`, `docs`, or `chore`. Breaking changes may also use `feat!:` or `fix!:`.
4. Link the relevant issue or work item in the description.
5. Keep the branch rebased on `main` and squash related work before merge.
6. Check CI output and make sure the quality gates pass.
7. Mark the pull request `Ready for Review` when it is actually ready.

More information can be found in `docs/contributing.md`.
